title: Marketplace Orders Checkout Terms: Shipping Charge, Capture and Sales Tax
content:
**Terms.** The shipping charge on a Marketplace Orders order is fixed at checkout from the delivery option's parameter column. A buyer whose Loop+ membership is in status trial, active, payment hold or cancel pending at the moment the order is placed pays the member shipping charge; every other buyer pays the non-member charge, waived when the item subtotal (unit price times quantity) is at or above the non-member free-shipping threshold. On Same-Day orders a member's shipping charge is waived when the item subtotal is at or above the member Same-Day free subtotal. A membership that is pending, lapsed or cancelled does not count.

The buyer's payment is captured once, for the order total, at the delivery option's capture point: at shipment for parcel options and at order placement for freight. Sales tax is collected and remitted by Northloop and never forms part of the seller's proceeds.

**Order total.** The order total is the unit price multiplied by the quantity, plus the shipping charge, plus the sales tax, rounded to the cent.

## Which shipping charge applies

| Loop+ membership status when the order is placed | Shipping charge paid |
|---|---|
| trial, active, payment hold, cancel pending | the member shipping charge (on Same-Day, waived at or above the member Same-Day free subtotal) |
| pending, lapsed, cancelled, or no membership | the non-member shipping charge, waived at or above the non-member free-shipping threshold where the option has one |

The status is read at the moment the order is placed; a later change of status does not change the charge fixed at checkout.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A hypothetical non-member orders 3 units at USD 9.50 on an option whose non-member charge is USD 5.99 with a USD 35.00 threshold. The item subtotal is 3 times 9.50, that is USD 28.50, below the threshold, so the shipping charge is USD 5.99. With a hypothetical sales tax of USD 2.28, the order total is 28.50 plus 5.99 plus 2.28, that is USD 36.77, captured once at the option's capture point. Had the buyer ordered 4 units, the subtotal of USD 38.00 would reach the threshold and the shipping charge would be USD 0.00.
